blocks.text: 🪝 Customs Duty Exempted on Lithium-Ion Battery Machinery & Charger Parts till March 2029. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Duty Exemptions: Customs duty exempted on automotive/medical display assembly parts, mobile wireless charging modules, and lithium-ion cell machinery till March 31, 2029.
Previous Duty Rates: Duties previously ranged from 7.5% to 15%.
⚠️ **Regulatory Compliance Trap:** Ensure exact compliance dates, institutional ceilings, and penalty provisions are verified during recall.
